items.title: Bill Holman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: It’s like I was telling Buddy before, that I don’t work much around here

ctx.x: Yeah, you’ve got to leave town.
It’s like I was telling Buddy before, that I don’t work much around here, much of my work is someplace else.
Well the guys in New York say the same thing.
